freeze_status: Exploratory; written after inline exploratory viewing already exposed 30 candidate transitions. Not a preregistration and not confirmatory evidence.
hypothesis: The retained two-times MAP01 video contains intermediate health HUD transitions missing from decision-only frame transcriptions; sampling its 10fps encoded frames and comparing a fixed red-pixel mask over the health ROI will localize those transitions to 0.2 source-second intervals.
limits: Post-hoc visual transcription from one 2x video; no continuous independent game-state sensor, no causal damage attribution, no action-effect/usefulness claim, no live test or allocation.
